mole.name: Mole Antonelliana
mole.price_text: Panoramic lift ≈ €9; check current price on the day
mole.hours: Closed Tuesday · roughly 09:00–19:00, check on the day
mole.tip: Book the lift slot online and go up near sunset for the best view over the city and the Alps.
mole.best: Late afternoon or sunset; clear days

cinema-museum.name: National Museum of Cinema
cinema-museum.price_text: ≈ €12 museum only; combined ticket with the lift costs more
cinema-museum.hours: Closed Tuesday · roughly 09:00–19:00, check on the day
cinema-museum.tip: The museum sits inside the Mole. Allow two hours and ride the glass lift at the end.

egyptian-museum.name: Egyptian Museum, Turin
egyptian-museum.tip: One of the world's great Egyptology collections. Book a timed ticket and skip the midday queue.

royal-palace.name: Royal Palace of Turin
royal-palace.price_text: ≈ €15 palace; gardens and armoury may cost extra
royal-palace.tip: Walk the state rooms then cross to the Royal Gardens for a quiet break.

venaria.name: La Venaria Reale
venaria.price_text: ≈ €16 palace and gardens; check on the day
venaria.tip: A huge royal estate outside the city. Give it half a day and wear comfortable shoes for the gardens.

superga.name: Basilica of Superga
superga.hours: Roughly 09:00–12:00 and 15:00–18:00, check on the day
superga.tip: Take the historic rack railway from Sassi and climb the dome for the classic Turin panorama.

sacra-san-michele.name: Sacra di San Michele
sacra-san-michele.price_text: ≈ €8 abbey entry; check on the day
sacra-san-michele.tip: A dramatic abbey on a rocky ridge in the Susa valley. It needs a half-day trip by car or bus.

allianz-stadium.name: Allianz Stadium
allianz-stadium.price_text: Match tickets vary widely; museum and tour priced separately
allianz-stadium.hours: Match days and tour times vary, check on the day
allianz-stadium.tip: Home of Juventus. Book a stadium tour or a match ticket well ahead, and check transport from the city.
allianz-stadium.best: Match day or a booked tour

teatro-regio.name: Teatro Regio
teatro-regio.price_text: Ticket prices vary by performance; check the season programme
teatro-regio.hours: Box office and performance times vary
teatro-regio.tip: Turin's main opera house. Book ahead for opera or ballet, and dress a little smartly.

porta-palazzo-market.name: Porta Palazzo market
porta-palazzo-market.price_text: Free to browse; bring cash for stalls
porta-palazzo-market.hours: Mon–Fri mornings; big Saturday market, check on the day
porta-palazzo-market.tip: Europe's largest open-air market. Go before noon for the food stalls and taste local cheese.

monte-dei-cappuccini.name: Monte dei Cappuccini viewpoint
monte-dei-cappuccini.tip: A short climb east of the river gives the best free view of the Mole and the Alps.

po-river-walk.name: Po river walk and Valentino Park
po-river-walk.tip: Walk the riverbank south from the centre to the Valentino park and its medieval village replica.

quadrilatero.name: Quadrilatero Romano walk
quadrilatero.price_text: Free to walk; food and drinks extra
quadrilatero.hours: Streets always open; bars busiest in the evening
quadrilatero.tip: The old Roman grid is now full of wine bars and small restaurants. Wander without a plan before dinner.

gianduiotto-tasting.name: Gianduiotto and chocolate tasting
gianduiotto-tasting.price_text: ≈ €8–15 for a tasting or a hot chocolate
gianduiotto-tasting.hours: Shop hours vary, check on the day
gianduiotto-tasting.tip: Turin invented gianduiotto. Try one in a historic café with a bicerin, the local coffee and chocolate drink.

porta-nuova-area.name: San Salvario neighbourhood walk
porta-nuova-area.price_text: Free to walk; food and drinks extra
porta-nuova-area.hours: Streets always open; liveliest at night
porta-nuova-area.tip: Near Porta Nuova station. Come in the evening for the best choice of casual restaurants and bars.
